scripts.build:cloudflare:community: pnpm run build:public && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env "" --outdir dist/cloudflare-community
scripts.build:cloudflare:managed: pnpm run build:public && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env managed --outdir dist/cloudflare-managed
scripts.db:migrate:cloudflare:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env managed
scripts.db:migrate:cloudflare:managed: wrangler d1 migrations apply synch-db --remote --env managed
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:community: pnpm run build:public && wrangler deploy && pnpm run db:migrate:cloudflare:community
scripts.upgrade:cloudflare:community: pnpm run build:public && wrangler deploy && pnpm run db:migrate:cloudflare:community
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:managed: pnpm run build:public && wrangler deploy --env managed && pnpm run db:migrate:cloudflare:managed
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build:public && vitest run --config ./vitest.unit.config.mts --exclude test/self-host/**/*.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:node: pnpm run build:public && vitest run --config ./vitest.unit.config.mts test/self-host
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run cf-typegen && tsgo --noEmit && pnpm run typecheck:web

AUTH_ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated email addresses allowed to create accounts, for example `you@example.com,family@example.com`.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Generate a random secret for Better Auth session signing, for example `openssl rand -hex 32`.

SYNC_TOKEN_SECRET.description: Generate a separate random secret for sync websocket token signing, for example `openssl rand -hex 32`.

OIDC_DISCOVERY_URL.description: Optional. OpenID Connect discovery document URL for single sign-on, for example `https://accounts.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration`. Register `{PUBLIC_URL}/api/auth/callback/oidc` as the redirect URI with your provider. Leave unset to disable OIDC sign-in; if set, OIDC_CLIENT_ID and OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET are also required.

OIDC_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. OAuth client ID issued by your OIDC provider. Required alongside OIDC_DISCOVERY_URL and OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET to enable OIDC sign-in.

OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. OAuth client secret issued by your OIDC provider. Required alongside OIDC_DISCOVERY_URL and OIDC_CLIENT_ID to enable OIDC sign-in.

OIDC_PROVIDER_NAME.description: Optional. Display name for the OIDC sign-in button, for example `Company SSO`. Defaults to "Single sign-on" when unset.

OIDC_SCOPES.description: Optional. Comma-separated OAuth scopes to request from your OIDC provider, for example `openid,profile,email`. Defaults to `openid,profile,email` when unset.

OIDC_ACCOUNT_ISSUER.description: Optional. Overrides the issuer identity used to scope linked OIDC accounts. Defaults to the origin of OIDC_DISCOVERY_URL when unset; only set this if your provider's issuer differs from that origin.

AUTH_EMAIL_PASSWORD.description: Optional. Accepts `enabled` (default) or `disabled`. Set to `disabled` to turn off email/password sign-in and require OIDC for all sign-ins.
